step1_analysis.description: A quad of NMOS transistors forming the switching core of a passive double-balanced mixer, typically used for downconversion in direct-conversion receivers.

paper_reference.title: RF Front-End of Direct Conversion Receiver RFIC for CDMA-2000

Voltage_Conversion_Gain.description: Ratio of the intermediate frequency (IF) output voltage amplitude to the radio frequency (RF) input voltage amplitude.

sky130_expected.calculation: A passive mixer core typically exhibits an insertion loss. The theoretical maximum voltage conversion gain is 2/pi (~ -3.9 dB).
sky130_expected.reasoning: Adjusted for a passive mixer core only, excluding the LNA and baseband amplifiers which provide the positive gain reported in the paper.

IIP3.description: Input third-order intercept point, indicating linearity.

sky130_expected.calculation: Passive mixers are highly linear. IIP3 is typically limited by the LO swing and switch ON-resistance.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Expected to be slightly higher than the entire front-end since the LNA usually bottlenecks linearity.

IIP2.description: Input second-order intercept point, critical for direct-conversion receivers.

sky130_expected.calculation: Depends heavily on device matching. In a perfectly symmetric schematic simulation, it approaches infinity.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Matches the paper's reported value, assuming typical layout mismatches.

sky130_expected.calculation: For a passive mixer, the noise figure is approximately equal to its insertion loss.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Corresponds to the expected -4 dB conversion gain.

IF_DC_Offset.description: DC voltage offset at the differential IF output, which can saturate baseband amplifiers in direct-conversion architectures.

sky130_expected.calculation: Symmetric differential topology should yield 0V offset ideally.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Ideal simulation without mismatch will yield near zero.

step3_testbench.description: Transient analysis to measure the voltage conversion gain and IF DC offset of the passive double-balanced mixer core.
step3_testbench.spice:
* RF Front-End Passive Mixer Core Testbench
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u
.param W_xm2=5u L_xm2=0.5u
.param W_xm3=5u L_xm3=0.5u
.param W_xm4=5u L_xm4=0.5u

* DUT
XM1 N2 LABEL_NET_0 N3 N3 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM2 N0 LABEL_NET_5 N10 N10 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}
XM3 N11 LABEL_NET_8 LABEL_NET_7 N11 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm3} w={W_xm3}
XM4 N12 LABEL_NET_11 LABEL_NET_10 N12 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm4} w={W_xm4}

* LO Signals (1.9 GHz, 0.9V DC bias, 1.8Vpp swing)
V_LO_p LABEL_NET_0 0 dc 0.9 sin(0.9 0.9 1.9G)
V_LO_p2 LABEL_NET_8 0 dc 0.9 sin(0.9 0.9 1.9G)
V_LO_n LABEL_NET_5 0 dc 0.9 sin(0.9 0.9 1.9G 0 0 180)
V_LO_n2 LABEL_NET_11 0 dc 0.9 sin(0.9 0.9 1.9G 0 0 180)

* RF Signals (2.0 GHz, 0.9V DC bias, 20mVpp differential swing)
V_RF_p N3 0 dc 0.9 sin(0.9 10m 2.0G)
V_RF_p2 N10 0 dc 0.9 sin(0.9 10m 2.0G)
V_RF_n LABEL_NET_7 0 dc 0.9 sin(0.9 10m 2.0G 0 0 180)
V_RF_n2 LABEL_NET_10 0 dc 0.9 sin(0.9 10m 2.0G 0 0 180)

* IF Output Connections (Routing DUT drains to IF ports)
V_short_IFp1 N2 IF_p 0
V_short_IFp2 N12 IF_p 0
V_short_IFn1 N0 IF_n 0
V_short_IFn2 N11 IF_n 0

* IF Load (Low-pass filter to extract 100 MHz IF, suppress RF/LO)
Rload_p IF_p 0 10k
Cload_p IF_p 0 0.1p
Rload_n IF_n 0 10k
Cload_n IF_n 0 0.1p

* Differential IF Voltage Source for Measurement
B_diff IF_diff 0 V=v(IF_p)-v(IF_n)

.control
  * Run transient analysis for 50ns (5 cycles of 100MHz IF)
  tran 10p 50n
  
  * Measure peak-to-peak IF voltage
  meas tran if_max max v(IF_diff) from=20n to=50n
  meas tran if_min min v(IF_diff) from=20n to=50n
  let if_ptp = if_max - if_min
  
  * Calculate Voltage Conversion Gain (RF diff input is 40mV peak-to-peak)
  let conv_gain = if_ptp / 0.04
  let conv_gain_db = 20 * log10(conv_gain)
  print conv_gain_db
  
  * Measure IF DC Offset
  meas tran if_dc avg v(IF_diff) from=20n to=50n
  print if_dc
  
  quit
.endc
